settings.heading: Pricing FAQ
settings.body: The questions we hear most from people comparing Kevin with alarms, cameras and timers.

settings.question: Is there a subscription?
settings.answer: No. You pay once. Software updates, the app and all built-in scenes are included for the life of the device. There is no monitoring plan because Kevin does not monitor: it deters.

settings.question: How does it compare with a monitored alarm?
settings.answer: A monitored alarm reacts after someone tests the door and charges every month. Kevin costs €579.95 once and works before the attempt, by making the home look occupied. Many owners run both: alarm for detection, Kevin for prevention.

settings.question: Where is shipping free?
settings.answer: Across the EU, Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Iceland. Prices and taxes are shown for your country at checkout.

settings.question: What if I change my mind?
settings.answer: Return Kevin within 30 days. Try it at home, step outside after dark and look at your own window. If it is not for you, send it back.

settings.title: Secure checkout
settings.body: Choose your cover, pay by card or your preferred method through Shopify checkout. You receive an order confirmation and a tracking number as soon as Kevin ships.
